story_description: As a new user, I need a guided tutorial overlay that walks me through the main UI areas after completing onboarding so that I can quickly understand how to use Blaze effectively without reading documentation.
task_description: Create the seven individual tutorial step view components, each targeting a specific UI area (New Session, Worktree Sidebar, File Tree, Terminal Panel, Chat Area, Chat Input, Right Sidebar) with spotlight cutouts, callout text, and navigation buttons.
atom_description: Implement seven SwiftUI tutorial step views that each render a spotlight cutout around a target UI area, display contextual callout text explaining that area functionality, and provide Previous/Next navigation buttons to move through the tutorial sequence.
problem_statement: After completing the wizard-style onboarding flow, users are dropped into the main Blaze interface which has multiple panes (sidebar, chat, terminal, right panel) that may not be immediately intuitive. Without a guided tour highlighting each area, users may miss key features or struggle to understand the workflow. The tutorial overlay must spotlight each area individually with clear explanations while allowing users to navigate forward and backward through the tour.

ui_states: Step 1 active state: Spotlight over New Session button, callout visible, Previous hidden, Next shows 'Next'
Step 2-6 active states: Spotlight over respective target, callout visible, Previous visible, Next shows 'Next'
Step 7 active state: Spotlight over Right Sidebar, callout visible, Previous visible, Next shows 'Finish'
Transition state: Previous spotlight fading out, new spotlight fading in, callout crossfading
Keyboard focused state: Current navigation button has focus ring indicator
VoiceOver active state: Callout text announced, navigation buttons labeled with actions
ui_interactions: User clicks Next button: Spotlight moves to next target area, step counter increments, callout updates
User clicks Previous button: Spotlight moves to previous target area, step counter decrements, callout updates
User clicks Finish button (step 7): Tutorial overlay dismisses, main app fully visible
User presses Right Arrow key: Same as clicking Next button
User presses Left Arrow key: Same as clicking Previous button (no-op on step 1)
User presses Escape key: Tutorial dismisses early with confirmation prompt (if implemented) or immediate dismiss
User presses Tab key: Focus moves between Previous and Next buttons
User resizes window: Spotlight position updates dynamically to follow target anchor
VoiceOver user navigates: Step title and body announced, button actions described
ui_copy: Step 1 body: 'Click here to create a new chat session. Choose your AI assistant (Claude, Gemini, or Codex) and start coding together.'
Step 2 body: 'Switch between Git branches and worktrees. Each worktree can have its own active session and file context.'
Step 3 body: 'Browse your project files. Drag files into the chat to add them as context, or right-click for quick actions.'
Step 4 body: 'Watch CLI commands execute in real-time. See exactly what your AI assistant is running and catch any issues early.'
Step 5 body: 'Your chat history with tool calls, file diffs, and responses. Review changes before they are applied to your code.'
Step 6 body: 'Type your prompts here. Use keyboard shortcuts for quick actions, and attach files by dragging or pasting.'
Step 7 body: 'Track session timeline, active tools, pending tasks, token usage, and hook triggers. Everything at a glance.'
edge_cases: User resizes window so target area moves off-screen: Spotlight and callout reposition or show fallback message
User opens Settings sheet while tutorial active: Tutorial pauses, resumes when sheet closes (or dismisses tutorial)
User changes theme while tutorial active: Callout colors update dynamically to match new theme
User with very large Dynamic Type: Callout expands to accommodate text, may need scroll if extremely large
User on small screen (MacBook Air): Callouts may need to use compact layout to fit
User rapidly clicks Next: Navigation is debounced, only one step advance per 250ms
User at step 7 clicks Previous then immediately Next: Both navigate correctly without race conditions
Target UI area is hidden (e.g., sidebar collapsed): Show callout with message to expand sidebar first or skip step
VoiceOver user navigates out of tutorial overlay: Focus trap keeps focus within tutorial until dismissed
failure_modes: Preference key returns zero rect for target: Show fallback spotlight at center screen with warning, log error
TutorialViewModel currentStep is nil or invalid: Default to step 1, log state corruption warning
Callout text fails to load from copy struct: Show placeholder text, log missing copy error
Animation spring timing causes jank on older hardware: Fall back to linear animation if frame drops detected
Memory pressure during tutorial: Views are lightweight, no special handling needed but log if views recreated frequently
SwiftUI view diffing causes flicker: Ensure step views have stable identity to prevent unnecessary recreation
rollback_plan: Remove TutorialStep1-7View files and TutorialStepContainer. Update TutorialOverlayView to show generic placeholder content. Tutorial infrastructure from O009 remains functional but shows static content instead of step-by-step tour. No persistence changes to reverse.

risks: Preference key anchor positions may be stale or incorrect if ContentView layout changes
Callout positioning algorithm may fail edge cases causing overlap with spotlight
Window resize race conditions could cause flickering spotlight
VoiceOver focus management may conflict with tutorial overlay modal behavior
Copy text may be too long for small callout width on compact windows
mitigations: Add fallback centering when preference key returns zero rect with warning log
Test callout positioning with all 4 screen corners and various window sizes
Debounce spotlight position updates on resize to prevent flicker
Test VoiceOver focus trap behavior explicitly and document known issues
Set maximum character limits on copy strings and test on 1024px width window
risk_register.blast_radius: Affects only Tutorial module. No impact on main chat, settings, or engine functionality. If tutorial steps fail, user can dismiss and use app normally without guided tour.
risk_register.fallback_plan: If step views have critical rendering issues, update TutorialOverlayView to show single summary view instead of step-by-step tour. Users see static help content rather than interactive spotlight tour. Tutorial still completes successfully.
